map.归一化后二者单调相关，但余弦更关注方向、对模长不敏感，适合文本嵌入；未归一化时欧: After normalisation the two are monotonically related, but cosine similarity focuses on direction and is insensitive to magnitude, which suits text embeddings; without normalisation the Euclidean distance is dominated by vector length and retrieval usually performs worse.
map.稠密检索的标准打分：查询向量与文档向量做点积后各自归一化，等价于夹角余弦。实际系: The standard scoring for dense retrieval: take the dot product of the query vector and the document vector and normalise each of them, which is equivalent to the cosine of the angle. Real systems commonly use an inner-product approximation plus an ANN index (HNSW/IVF) for speed, in which case the vectors must already be normalised, otherwise the inner product is skewed by the magnitude.
